title: Dolly Parton's free book programme sees 950 new sign-ups and $150,000 in donations after her death
summary_full: In the wake of Dolly Parton's passing, the Imagination Library saw a remarkable increase in registrations. In August alone, Knox County welcomed nearly 950 new children to the program. Additionally, over $150,000 was generated through a fundraising initiative to bolster the library's mission. Established in 1995, this program ensures that young readers receive free books every month until the age of five, proudly distributing over four million books to date.
